claims.statement: Elastic documents API keys created in the Elastic Cloud Enterprise UI for authenticating calls to the Elastic Cloud Enterprise RESTful API, as an alternative to bearer tokens obtained with a username and password.

sources.supports: For key-based API authentication, you can create an API key through the Elastic Cloud Enterprise UI. Once created, you can specify the key in the header of your API calls to authenticate.

claims.statement: An Elastic Cloud Enterprise API key has the same permissions as its owner and by default expires three months after creation, configurable to Never.

sources.supports: The API key has the same permissions as the API key owner.; By default, the API key will expire three months after its creation date, but you can set the expiration to Never.

openQuestions.question: The page read does not state the header scheme or any key grammar; whether the ECE key shares the Cloud API key representation is unresolved.
